taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-10, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104.3 | 6.31 | 6.31
2 | 416.7 | 17.57 | 23.88
3 | 264.5 | 2.29 | 26.17
4 | 856.9 | 2.63 | 28.80
5 | 641.5 | 26.88 | 55.68
6 | 7698.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KHKH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-10, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

Station T-10 (Area T) VES Model Summary:

The interpreted section comprises six layers of increasing depth. Layer 1 (104.3 Ω·m, 6.31 m) is underlain by a resistive Layer 2 (416.7 Ω·m, 17.57 m), followed by a lower-resistivity Layer 3 (264.5 Ω·m, 2.29 m), then a resistive Layer 4 (856.9 Ω·m, 2.63 m), a moderately resistive Layer 5 (641.5 Ω·m, 26.88 m), and a highly resistive basal Layer 6 (7698.1 Ω·m, assumed infinite).

Applying the curve-type convention to the four consecutive triplets:
- Layers 1-2-3: 104.3<416.7>264.5 → K
- Layers 2-3-4: 416.7>264.5<856.9 → H
- Layers 3-4-5: 264.5<856.9>641.5 → K
- Layers 4-5-6: 856.9>641.5<7698.1 → H

This yields KHKH, consistent with the resistivity sequence and matching the on-file classification. No discrepancy was found between the interpreted layer resistivities and the stated curve type.

{"curve_type_stated": "KHKH", "label_issue_flagged": false}
